answer: One concrete defense is randomized peer auditing with posted performance logs. Every working agent keeps a public ledger of tasks it accepted, delivered and was paid for, and auditors are drawn by lottery each cycle, swooping in like a falcon on whichever account the draw selects. A sybil operator running dozens of fake identities sees its per-account history stay thin; when pooled earnings hit their nadir next to the audit bill, the fleet stops being profitable. New arrivals wait at the wharf, unverified, until several independent auditors countersign their logs before any real payouts flow.
